messages:
sara-support: Heads up — p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~420ms to ~1.8s around 15:20 UTC after we pushed the matrix-calib-v2 int8 profile at 15:11. Errors are low (no 5xx), but tail latency across multiple tenants spiked. example req_id=req_9a7c4b; gpu util ~72% on the pool, but token latency shows long KV fetchs in traces.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-17T15:21:05Z p95=310ms p99=1.82s route=/v1/generate pool=matrix-prod profile=matrix-calib-v2

jonah-runtime: Thanks — can you paste a raw trace (span ids) and one noisy request payload? Also what percentage of traffic is on matrix-calib-v2 now? If it's large we should canary revert.

sara-support: Traffic: ~62% of matrix models; rolling out as default yesterday. Attaching a minimal repro: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-matrix","input":"summarize: long document"}'
Observed timings (client-side): connect 15ms, tls 30ms, server wait 1.7s. Trace spans show long "kv_fetch" spans on layers 10-14 repeatedly.

li-ml: Noted — matrix-calib-v2 added mixed int8/fp8 layer-level packing for cache compaction. If layer ordering differs between compilation and runtime cache layout we can get extra replay/lookup churn which explodes p99. Two immediate mitigations: 1) revert profile -> fp16 fallback, 2) disable mixed-precision packing on the pool and re-warm cache. Option commands below.

li-ml: Command to rollback canary (low-risk):
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --name=matrix-calib-v2 --strategy=canary --percent=5 --reason="p99 surge"
```
Or full revert: `redwoodctl rollout revert --name=matrix-calib-v2 --force`

jonah-runtime: Also we can hot-route high-SLA tenants to an fp16-only pool while we investigate. Example route patch: 
```yaml
routes:
  - match: tenant_id in ["acme-corp","finco"]
    target_pool: matrix-fp16-dedicated
```
I'll prepare the patch if we go that way.

mike-qa: Quick repro steps I ran locally (using staging weights):
1) start curl load: for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -X POST ... & done
2) collect response times: saw 10% responses >1.2s, tail at ~1.9s
Logs show repeated: `kv_cache_miss layer=12 key=0x3f9a` and retries.

jonah-runtime: One more short-term safe knob: reduce continuous batching window for matrix-prod to 10ms and set max_batch_tokens=512 to reduce amplification of cache misses. Command: `redwoodctl config set pool/matrix-prod batching.window_ms=10 batching.max_batch_tokens=512`

sara-support: Can we prioritize: 1) canary revert to 5% now, 2) route top 3 paying tenants to fp16 pool, 3) reduce batching window, 4) open an incident ticket and doc the repro. Who takes which?

jonah-runtime: I'll do the canary revert and batching change. Starting now. Will post rollback progress.

li-ml: I'll run a binary search over layer-level quant settings to find offending layer(s) and prepare a profile patch (matrix-calib-v2a) that disables mixed-packing on layers 8-15. ETA 3 hours.

mike-qa: I'll run regression tests against the patch and smoke-check output quality vs fp16. Also collect p95/p99 before/after.

ops-bot: [ACTION] Incident created INC-2026-319: "matrix-calib-v2 p99 surge" assigned to runtime+ml.

devex: Please add a short note to the public changelog that we rolled a calibration profile back and are investigating latency impact. I can draft language once rollback confirmed.

sara-support: Thanks team. Jonah — ping here when canary at 5% is live and any metrics. Li — update if you find layer mismatch. I'll notify affected customers with a brief post. :thumbsup:
